SELECT pois.poi_name, ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, target.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters

    SELECT pois.geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE pois.poi_name ILIKE '%Aquarium Outfitters Carolina%' AND pois.addr_city ILIKE '%Wake Forest%' AND pois.addr_state ILIKE '%NC%'
    LIMIT 1
) AS source
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (

    LIMIT 1
) AS target

  AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, source.geometry, 160000)

ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> target.geometry;
